npc.technique.value: Ledger — writes a debt onto a target; the debt comes due as damage at a time of the user's choosing
Undertow — drags anything standing on a surface the user has touched a half-step off balance
Lamplight — objects the user names begin to glow and cannot be hidden, shadowed or veiled
Second Mouth — a wound opens into a mouth that speaks the words the victim has not said yet
Hand-Me-Down — the user borrows a technique they have personally witnessed, badly, for one exchange
Rust — accelerates decay in anything metal or man-made within arm's reach
Headcount — the user always knows how many living things are inside a space they have sealed
Stillwater — sound dies inside a radius the user holds open, and so does any technique that needs a spoken name
Tally — every injury they take is owed back, in full, to whoever dealt it
Hush — removes sound from a space, including the sound of what moves in it
Splice — joins two surfaces permanently, whatever they are made of
Borrowed Time — a few seconds taken from later and spent now
Low Tide — drags fluid out of anything, slowly and without contact
The Usher — compels a target to walk somewhere they have already been
Foxfire — a cold flame that burns only cursed energy, not flesh
Pins — fixes an object in space until the user looks away from it
Second Opinion — makes a wound present as something less serious than it is
Inheritance — borrows one technique from a blood relative, once per day
Paper Weight — makes a thing as heavy as the attention paid to it
Remainder — whatever is divided leaves a remnant that acts on its own
Stitchwork — closes what is open, in cloth, in skin, in doorways
Overhear — repeats, in the user's voice, something said in that room before
Cold Call — reaches a person's attention at any distance, once, briefly
The Draft — moves air hard enough to be a wall, or a blade
Plumb Line — finds the lowest point of any space, and what has collected there
Dry Rot — ages worked material: timber, cloth, rope, paper
Switchback — reverses the direction of anything already moving
Understudy — copies the last technique used against them, badly, once
Quietus — ends a technique already in progress, at a cost
Long Shadow — their shadow acts a half-second ahead of them
